TCS KA PORSCHE KE SATH MEGA DEAL:
RS. 11,500 CRORE KA HISTORIC AI MOBILITY PACT!
pending_posts.subheadline: Tata TCS ne Porsche AG ke sath 5-year strategic agreement sign kiya. Porsche ki IT subsidiary MHP ko RS. 3,575 Crore (€320M) me kiya acquire.
pending_posts.caption: 🚗 Mega Tech Deal: TCS aur Porsche AG ke beech hua RS. 11,500 Crore (€1.25B) ka historic AI partnership! 🇮🇳🇩🇪 Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) ne European automotive market me ab tak ka sabse bada dhamaka kar diya hai! TCS ne luxury sports car maker Porsche AG ke sath 5-saal ka €1.25 Billion (lagbhag RS. 11,500 Crore) ka strategic pact sign kiya hai. Iske sath hi TCS Porsche ki digital consulting subsidiary MHP ko €320 Million (RS. 3,575 Crore) me acquire karegi. Dono companiyan milkar next-generation AI Mobility Centre of Excellence banayengi jo automated driving aur digital manufacturing ko naye levels par le jayega! Kya Tata TCS ka yeh acquisition Indian IT sector ke liye game-changer साबित hoga? Comment karein! 👇💬 Source: Indian Express #tcs #porsche #tatagroup #aimobility #businessnews
